IT’S MIND
 BOGGLING.
Relativity Solid reactive coverstock is Brunswick’s latest advancement in our performance enhancing coverstock technology.
Matched with the Mastermind Low RG core, the Mastermind Strategy produces easy length through the heads with
outstanding bite in the mid-lane delivering a strong and controllable hook motion on medium to heavy oil lane conditions.
